description: Calculate SigRank cascade metrics from four non-negative token counts without submitting data. Returns Yield, Leverage, Velocity, SNR, and 10xDEV. No data is persisted. Required top-level numeric arguments, e.g. {"input": 1000000, "output": 50000, "cache_read": 20000000, "cache_write": 500000}.

cache_read.description: Tokens read from prompt cache (reused context).

cache_write.description: Tokens written to prompt cache (new context stored for reuse).

input.description: Total input tokens consumed in the session.

name: rank_paste

leverage.description: Leverage = cache_read / input. Reusable context amplification. Null when input is zero.

non_compounding.description: True if cache_write is zero (no compounding context).

snr.description: Signal-to-noise ratio = output / (input + output). Null when input is zero.

velocity.description: Velocity = output / input. Output per unit of input. Null when input is zero.

yield_.description: Yield (Υ) = (cache_read × output) / input². Headline cascade efficiency. Null when input is zero.

title: Rank Paste — Local Token Cascade Calculator
